trip.todo.step1.item1.body.zh: 出发前，按本次护照和入境日查官方规则。
trip.todo.step1.item1.body.en: Before you travel, check the official rules for your passport and entry date.

trip.todo.step1.item2.body.zh: 如在中国转机或过境，按官方页面核对联程、口岸和停留范围。
trip.todo.step1.item2.body.en: Transiting through China? Check your onward route, ports and permitted area.

trip.todo.step1.item2.tip.zh: 返程和过境的条件不同，请核对联程。
trip.todo.step1.item2.tip.en: Check the onward route. A return trip has different rules.

trip.todo.step1.item3.body.zh: 备好有效护照和行程材料。签证办理入口和材料清单请查领事服务网。
trip.todo.step1.item3.body.en: Have your passport and itinerary ready. Check consular guidance for visa forms and documents.

trip.todo.step1.item4.body.zh: 到移民局官网核对是否要填入境卡。需要时按页面填报。
trip.todo.step1.item4.body.en: Check whether you need an arrival card. If you do, use the official form.

trip.todo.step1.item5.body.zh: 出发前到海关官网核对携带物品和申报要求。
trip.todo.step1.item5.body.en: Before you travel, check what you can carry and what you need to declare.

trip.todo.step1.item5.tip.zh: 入境卡与海关申报请分别查看。
trip.todo.step1.item5.tip.en: Check the arrival card and customs declaration separately.

trip.todo.step1.item6.body.zh: 部分免签安排截至2026年12月31日。请按官方名单核对。
trip.todo.step1.item6.body.en: Some visa waivers run through 31 Dec 2026. Check the official list.

trip.todo.step1.item7.body.zh: 一项免签安排延至2027年12月31日。请查官方公告。
trip.todo.step1.item7.body.en: One visa waiver extension runs through 31 Dec 2027. Check the official notice.

trip.todo.step1.reminder.zh: 出发前，记得核对入境要求。
trip.todo.step1.reminder.en: Check the entry rules before you leave.

trip.todo.step1.prompt.nationality.en: Which country’s passport will you use?

trip.todo.step2.item1.body.zh: 按航班号或车次核对机场、航站楼或车站。
trip.todo.step2.item1.body.en: Check your flight or train number for the airport, terminal or station.

trip.todo.step2.item2.body.zh: 国际航班落地后跟着到达标识走，备好证件，按现场指引通关。
trip.todo.step2.item2.body.en: After an international flight, follow Arrivals and have your documents ready for checks.

trip.todo.step2.item3.body.zh: 按航班号找行李转盘。行李没到时，带行李牌找航司柜台。
trip.todo.step2.item3.body.en: Find your carousel by flight number. Missing a bag? Take the bag tag to the airline desk.

trip.todo.step2.item4.body.zh: 确认到达的机场或车站，再查进城路线。夜间出行先查运营时间。
trip.todo.step2.item4.body.en: Check routes from your airport or station. For late arrivals, check operating hours.

trip.todo.step2.item5.body.zh: 转机前问航司是否要取行李、重新托运或换航站楼。
trip.todo.step2.item5.body.en: Ask your airline if you need to collect and recheck bags or change terminals.

trip.todo.step2.item5.tip.zh: 分开出票时，先向航司确认行李怎么走。
trip.todo.step2.item5.tip.en: Booked separate tickets? Ask the airline what to do with your bags.

trip.todo.step2.reminder.zh: 到达信息还没定？确定后再来补。
trip.todo.step2.reminder.en: Still planning your arrival? You can add the details later.

trip.todo.step2.prompt.date.en: What day do you arrive in China?

trip.todo.step2.prompt.flight_or_train.zh: 航班号或车次是多少？（选填）
trip.todo.step2.prompt.flight_or_train.en: Flight or train number, if known?

trip.todo.step3.item1.body.zh: 订房时把姓名和证件对一下。再看入住时间、取消规则和押金。
trip.todo.step3.item1.body.en: Match the booking name to your ID. Check check-in times, cancellation terms and deposits.

trip.todo.step3.item2.body.zh: 入住时带上有效护照等证件，向前台确认登记。
trip.todo.step3.item2.body.en: Bring your passport or other valid ID, and ask the front desk about registration.

trip.todo.step3.item3.body.zh: 把酒店名称、地址和订单存好，方便路上查看。
trip.todo.step3.item3.body.en: Keep the hotel name, address and booking handy for the trip there.

trip.todo.step3.item4.body.zh: 住亲友家或其他非旅馆住所时，按移民局指引核对登记流程。
trip.todo.step3.item4.body.en: Staying with friends or outside a hotel? Check the immigration authority’s registration guide.

trip.todo.step3.item4.tip.zh: 有住宿订单，也请确认登记办妥。
trip.todo.step3.item4.tip.en: Even with a booking, check that registration is complete.

trip.todo.step3.item5.body.zh: 住在旅馆时，由旅馆办理住宿登记。入住时可向前台确认。
trip.todo.step3.item5.body.en: Hotels register their guests. You can confirm this with the front desk at check-in.

trip.todo.step3.item6.body.zh: 住非旅馆住所时，应在入住后24小时内由本人或留宿人办理登记。
trip.todo.step3.item6.body.en: Outside hotels, you or your host must register within 24 hours of arriving at the property.

trip.todo.step3.reminder.zh: 住哪儿还没定？选好再回来也行。
trip.todo.step3.reminder.en: Still choosing where to stay? You can come back later.

trip.todo.step3.prompt.budget.zh: 你每晚的住宿预算是多少？
trip.todo.step3.prompt.budget.en: What’s your hotel budget per night?

trip.todo.step4.item1.body.zh: 先看商户受理的卡标识，再备些人民币现金。
trip.todo.step4.item1.body.en: Check which cards the shop accepts, and carry some cash in yuan.

trip.todo.step4.item2.body.zh: 在支付宝或微信支付按提示绑卡。支付前核对费用和限额。
trip.todo.step4.item2.body.en: Follow Alipay or WeChat Pay’s steps to add your card. Check fees and limits before paying.

trip.todo.step4.item3.body.zh: 换汇认准有标识的网点。用ATM前先看银行卡标识和费用。
trip.todo.step4.item3.body.en: Use a marked exchange point. At an ATM, check the card logos and fees before withdrawing.

trip.todo.step4.item4.title.en: Ask about tax refunds before buying

trip.todo.step4.item4.body.zh: 购物前问店里能否退税。按指引出示证件，留好发票和退税申请单。
trip.todo.step4.item4.body.en: Ask about refunds before buying. Show ID as directed and keep the invoice and refund form.

trip.todo.step4.item5.title.en: Claim your tax refund before leaving

trip.todo.step4.item5.body.zh: 离境时按口岸指引验核商品，再到退税代理点办理。
trip.todo.step4.item5.body.en: Follow the port’s instructions for Customs checks, then go to the refund counter.

trip.todo.step4.item5.tip.zh: 商品要托运？先问清验核顺序。
trip.todo.step4.item5.tip.en: Checking the goods in? Ask when Customs needs to see them.

trip.todo.step4.item6.body.zh: 公开上限为单笔5,000美元、每年50,000美元。以付款页为准。
trip.todo.step4.item6.body.en: Published caps are US$5,000 per payment and US$50,000 per year. Check your app’s limit.

trip.todo.step4.item6.tip.zh: 额度以本人账户实际显示为准。
trip.todo.step4.item6.tip.en: Your own limit depends on your account and card issuer.

trip.todo.step4.item7.body.zh: 一般单笔不超过200元免平台费，超过通常按全额收3%。以付款页为准。
trip.todo.step4.item7.body.en: Usually no platform fee up to RMB 200, or 3% of the full amount above. Check before paying.

trip.todo.step4.item7.tip.en: Your card issuer may charge separately.

trip.todo.step4.item8.body.zh: 同人同日同退税店满200元，未用商品须在购物后90天内随行出境。
trip.todo.step4.item8.body.en: RMB 200+ per person, refund shop and day. Take unused goods out within 90 days of purchase.

trip.todo.step4.item8.tip.zh: 只计合资格商品，即买即退另有期限。
trip.todo.step4.item8.tip.en: Only eligible goods count. Instant refunds have a separate deadline.

trip.todo.step4.reminder.zh: 买东西前，先确认手上的付款方式。
trip.todo.step4.reminder.en: Before you shop, check which ways you can pay.

trip.todo.step5.item1.body.zh: 想办本地手机卡？先查运营商网点和套餐，带上护照。
trip.todo.step5.item1.body.en: Buying a local SIM? Check the carrier’s stores and plans, and bring your passport.

trip.todo.step5.item2.body.zh: 先查手机型号和购买地区，再看运营商的开通要求。
trip.todo.step5.item2.body.en: Check your phone model and where you bought it, then check the carrier’s setup rules.

trip.todo.step5.item3.body.zh: 出发前问原运营商中国大陆是否覆盖，以及通话、短信和流量的费用。
trip.todo.step5.item3.body.en: Ask your carrier about mainland China coverage and charges for calls, texts and data.

trip.todo.step5.item4.title.en: Check if you can get text codes

trip.todo.step5.item4.body.zh: 买旅行eSIM前先查套餐。还要确认哪个号码能接收验证码。
trip.todo.step5.item4.body.en: Check what your travel eSIM includes. Make sure you have a number that can receive codes.

trip.todo.step5.item4.tip.zh: 只含流量的套餐不能替代短信线路。
trip.todo.step5.item4.tip.en: A data-only plan can’t replace a line that receives texts.

trip.todo.step5.item5.body.zh: 先打开地图和支付App，核对语言、登录和可用功能。
trip.todo.step5.item5.body.en: Open your map and payment apps. Check language, sign-in and available features.

trip.todo.step5.item6.body.zh: 大陆运营商的iPhone eSIM限Apple所列机型，须去营业厅核验开通。
trip.todo.step5.item6.body.en: Mainland carrier eSIMs work only on Apple’s listed iPhones. Activate in store with ID.

trip.todo.step5.reminder.zh: 还在选联网方式？先查手机和套餐是否匹配。
trip.todo.step5.reminder.en: Still choosing a way to get online? Check what works with your phone.

trip.todo.step6.item1.body.zh: 在机场或车站，跟着出租车标识到指定上车点。
trip.todo.step6.item1.body.en: At the airport or station, follow the taxi signs to the designated pickup area.

trip.todo.step6.item2.body.zh: 看清上车区和出口。下单前在打车页面核对支付方式。
trip.todo.step6.item2.body.en: Check the pickup zone and exit. Confirm your payment options before booking.

trip.todo.step6.item3.title.en: Check how to pay for the metro

trip.todo.step6.item3.body.zh: 出发前查当地地铁可用的卡、乘车码和购票方式。
trip.todo.step6.item3.body.en: Check which cards, ride codes and tickets your city’s metro accepts.

trip.todo.step6.item3.tip.zh: 用外卡前，先看闸机或窗口标识。
trip.todo.step6.item3.tip.en: Check the signs at the gate or counter before using your card.

trip.todo.step6.item4.title.en: Check how to pay for the bus

trip.todo.step6.item4.body.zh: 先看这一线路的付款标识，再选现金、交通卡或乘车码。
trip.todo.step6.item4.body.en: Check the payment signs for your route before using cash, a transit card or a ride code.

trip.todo.step6.item4.tip.zh: 乘车码请先核对城市和线路。
trip.todo.step6.item4.tip.en: Check that your ride code works for the city and route.

trip.todo.step6.item5.title.en: Get ready to buy a train ticket

trip.todo.step6.item5.body.zh: 到中国铁路官网核对护照购票和身份核验，按页面提示办理。
trip.todo.step6.item5.body.en: Use China Railway’s official site to check how to buy tickets and verify your passport.

trip.todo.step6.item6.title.en: Check the gate before you tap

trip.todo.step6.item6.body.zh: 拍卡乘地铁时，进出站用同一张实体卡，或同一设备里的同一凭证。
trip.todo.step6.item6.body.en: When tapping in and out, use the same card or the same card on the same device.

trip.todo.step6.item6.tip.zh: 先查你所在城市和闸机的支持范围。
trip.todo.step6.item6.tip.en: Check your city and the gate for supported payment methods.

trip.todo.step6.item7.title.en: Bring the ID you used to book

trip.todo.step6.item7.body.zh: 坐高铁请带购票用的证件原件。闸机读不了时，请走人工通道。
trip.todo.step6.item7.body.en: Bring the original ID you booked with. If the gate can’t read it, use the staffed lane.

trip.todo.step6.reminder.zh: 第一次坐车？先挑一种你用得上的付款方式。
trip.todo.step6.reminder.en: First ride? Pick a way to pay that works for you.

chips.en: How do I get into town?

chips.zh: 转机要重新托运行李吗？

chips.en: How do I add my card?
How do I get a bus code?
